DEPARTMENT OF DEFENCE AND NATIONAL SECURITY STUDIES
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH
Advertisement for Guest Faculty (Asst. Professor)
The department of Defence and National Security Studies invites application for the appointment of Guest
Faculty, Asst. Professor (01 Post) for the even semester session 2023-24.
Educational Qualifications:- M.A. in Defence and Strategic Studies incl. UGC NET or UGC latest guidelines for
the appointment of Assistant Professors in Universities or Colleges.
Applications are required to send their bio-data (incl. contact details) along with certificates and testimonials to
reach the office of the department of Defence and National Security Studies latest by 7th February, 2024 before
5:00 p.m. in the department office. Applications may be mailed to danss@pu.ac.in or submitted hard copy in the
department office.
-sd-
Chairman
